reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Legal tools for equitable AI use
themes.definition: Calls for international collaboration on guidelines and legal instruments ensuring equitable, development-oriented use of AI.
themes.inclusion: Passages calling for international guidelines or legal tools governing AI development and equitable use.
themes.exclusion: Passages naming AI risk only in a list without a governance call.
themes.boundary_cases: Support for the Summit of the Future resolution tied to AI may also be coded AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: We call for genuine international collaboration to establish guidelines that will lead to legal tools guaranteeing the development and equitable use of artificial intelligence

themes.label: AI for growth and development
themes.definition: AI framed as conducive to development, growth, productivity and knowledge worldwide.
themes.inclusion: Passages linking AI to global development, growth or productivity.
themes.boundary_cases: Development framing embedded in a governance call can be coded with both themes.

examples.quote: conducive to development, growth, productivity and knowledge throughout the world

themes.label: AI risks listed among global priorities
themes.definition: AI risks named briefly in a list of global priorities (climate, sustainable development) without elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Passages naming 'the risks of AI' as one item among broader priorities.
themes.exclusion: Passages that specify which AI risks or propose responses.
themes.boundary_cases: A fragmentary sentence listing AI risks after a conflict discussion remains a list mention.

examples.quote: The risks of artificial intelligence and the imperative of sustainable development.

value.rationale: Comoros 2024 calls for international legal tools for equitable, development-oriented AI, while 2026 only lists AI risks among global priorities in a passage dominated by Palestine and the Mayotte dispute.
